_meta.purpose: Canonical data-only declaration of ADR-0537 bootstrap tiers 0..10 and the dependency semantics the DOGFOOD-002 Buck2 tier-dependency lint consumes; housed under specs/dogfood/ to avoid adding a new root-hub top-level pointer in this data-only slice.

tier_contract.lint_rollout: born-advisory; promote shadow -> warn -> enforce per ADR-0536 D-7
tier_contract.runtime_rule: A Tier-N service may link/call live clients only for services whose bootstrap_tier is <= N.

dependency_semantics.legacy_untyped_manifest_dependency_polic: Do not treat legacy untyped arrays as ADR-0537 live-client edges until each edge is re-declared with one of the semantics below.

kinds.definition: A runtime link or network/client crate that requires the target Oyatie service to be live during normal operation or bootstrap.
Compilation, Buck/Cargo target, proc-macro, schema, or generator input only; target service need not be live.
IDL/OpenAPI/AsyncAPI/proto/model generation only; target service need not be live.
Test fixture/harness/dev dependency only; never shipped as runtime code.
Static signed seed/snapshot material consumed before the producer service exists.
Pinned local configuration that is not fetched from a live service.
ADR-0510 bridge implementation behind a stable owned Rust interface; not an Oyatie live-client edge.

tiers.name: root-ceremony-and-owned-stack-base
tiers.meaning: Offline root ceremony plus cloud-kernel/cloud-os/cloud-k8s base; no live service dependency.

tiers.name: kms-unseal
tiers.meaning: cloud-kms boots on its own local Raft quorum; explicitly not oya-data.

tiers.name: secrets-and-workload-identity
tiers.meaning: cloud-secrets and SPIFFE/workload identity; fetch-fail = deploy-fail.

tiers.name: identity-provider
tiers.meaning: IdP control plane and primordial operator domain seeded from the root ceremony.

tiers.name: embedded-cedar-pdp
tiers.meaning: Signed content-addressed Cedar policy bundle distribution; service PDPs evaluate locally.

tiers.name: network-dns
tiers.meaning: Network/DNS data plane serves hand-signed seed snapshot before its control plane exists.

tiers.name: persistence
tiers.meaning: oya-data/cloud-data persistence; bootstrap metadata lives in a separate single-Raft bootstrap metastore.

tiers.name: cas-storage
tiers.meaning: Object storage/CAS boots from static config; stores policy bundles, zone snapshots, audit anchors.

tiers.name: messaging
tiers.meaning: Queue/stream/bus substrate behind owned Rust client interface; launch-primary broker is transitional.

tiers.name: audit
tiers.meaning: Audit pipeline anchors signed digest chain with messaging and CAS WORM available.

forbidden_edges_assertion.reason: ADR-0537 recursion break #1: oya-data encrypts with KMS keys, so KMS state must not live in oya-data.
ADR-0537 recursion break #2: data substrate bootstrap metadata lives in a separate bootstrap metastore, not in oya-data itself.
ADR-0537 step 7 CAS must boot before messaging and cannot discover itself from systems depending on CAS.
Policy distribution/PDP bootstrap precedes audit; audit depends on policy, not reverse.
Workload identity comes up before the IdP control plane per ADR-0537 step 2 -> step 3.

validation_invariants: Every service_declarations[*].bootstrap_tier is an integer in [0, 10].
Every top-level cloud/*/manifest.json and oya/*/manifest.json service is declared exactly once.
Legacy untyped manifest dependency arrays are not live-client authority until migrated to dependency_edges.
